usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.beta.assistants.create(model: "string", name: "string", description: "string", instructions: "string", reasoning_effort: "none", tools: [{ "type" => "code_interpreter" }], tool_resources: { "code_interpreter" => { "file_ids" => ["string"] }, "file_search" => nil }, metadata: { "key" => "string" }, temperature: 1, top_p: 1, response_format: "auto")
pp result
